name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is an early-stage gold and silver explorer based in Reno, Nevada, focused on mineral royalty creation, exploration streaming, and project acceleration in Nevada's Walker Lane shear zone. Its Lapon Canyon project (held via earn-in with Walker River Resources) returned positive 2025 drilling results expanding gold mineralization, and its Agai-Pah property in Mineral County has returned high-grade surface silver assays up to 1,829 g/t. The company also holds the Swales, Loman, and Belshazzar properties and is at the exploration stage.
